title: Quickly Optimized
description: A modpack to increase your performance!
body:
Have you ever had trouble with the fps of your minecraft??

Look no further for a solution as I introduce you to Quickly Optimized!
This modpack contains **only** performance mods(It doesnt include QoL mods)

The modpack contains a number of mods which modify how the game works or completely rewrite it,
many are fixes for memory leaks, etc.
